timeoutPrompts: Masie: Hello? The greenhouse is so quiet, can you hear me?
Masie: {PlayerName}? Did you put the phone down?
Masie: Hello? I'm going to mist the ferns if you're busy.

nodes.partnerDialogue: Masie: Oh, wonderful, you picked up! I was just propagating the rare jade vine cuttings before sunset.

choices.choiceText: Did the monstera bloom open up fully?
Your voice always sounds so soothing.
How do you manage that entire conservatory?

nodes.partnerDialogue: Masie: It did! The creamy variegation on the newest leaf is stunning. Nature is truly patient.

choices.choiceText: I'd love to come see it in person.
Your botanical posts are my favorite part of the day.

nodes.partnerDialogue: Masie: Working with plants teaches you to breathe and slow down. You should try it sometime!

choices.choiceText: Only if you're the one teaching me.

nodes.partnerDialogue: Masie: One leaf at a time! Consistent soil moisture and gentle indirect sunlight is all they need.
Masie: The greenhouse gate is always unlocked for you. Have a restful evening, {PlayerName}!
